description: This file defines message types and data structures used for control and device communication in an Android Cuttlefish frontend system, including registration, connection, and configuration messages.

classes.name: ControlMsgHeader
classes.description: Header for control messages indicating message type.

classes.name: PreRegisterMsg
classes.description: Message sent for pre-registration, including group info and device list.

classes.name: RegistrationStatusReport
classes.description: Report of registration status for devices.

classes.name: PreRegistrationResponse
classes.description: A list of registration status reports sent as response.

classes.name: RegisterMsg
classes.description: Message used by a device to register itself, including device details.

classes.name: ConnectMsg
classes.description: Message used to initiate a connection for a device.

classes.name: ForwardMsg
classes.description: Message for forwarding payloads, with an optional client ID.

classes.name: ClientMsg
classes.description: Message from or to clients, includes message type and payload.

classes.name: ErrorMsg
classes.description: Structured error message with optional details.

classes.name: NewConnMsg
classes.description: Message indicating a new connection for a device.

classes.name: NewConnReply
classes.description: Reply to a new connection request, includes connection ID and device info.

classes.name: InfraConfig
classes.description: Configuration message containing ICE server info for peer connections.

classes.name: IceServer
classes.description: Details for ICE server used in infrastructure configuration.

classes.name: DeviceDescriptor
classes.description: Descriptor information for a device, including ID, group, owner, name, and ADB port.

classes.name: DeviceInfoReply
classes.description: Response containing device descriptor and registration info.
